Exercise: Windmills

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- rotation
- unilateral_hip_abduction

Primary Muscles:

- abductors

Secondary Muscles:

- glutes
- hamstrings
- lower back

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_hip_mobility_and_stability
- strengthen_glutes_and_hamstrings

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain
- Recent hip surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Windmills with Dumbbell, equipment: ['dumbbell']

Substitution Options:

- name: Single-Leg Bridge, force: pull, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and your legs straight. This will be your starting position.
- Lift one leg and quickly cross it over your body, attempting to touch the ground near the opposite hand.
- Return to the starting position, and repeat with the opposite leg. Continue to alternate for 10-20 repetitions.
